
{{alias}}( value )
    Returns the SGD loss function string associated with an SGD loss function
    enumeration constant.

    Parameters
    ----------
    value: integer
        Loss function enumeration constant.

    Returns
    -------
    out: string|null
        Loss function string.

    Examples
    --------
    > var str = 'epsilon-insensitive';
    > var v = {{alias:@stdlib/ml/base/sgd/loss-function-str2enum}}( str );
    > var out = {{alias}}( v )
    'epsilon-insensitive'

    See Also
    --------
